blocks.x: Process industries run on continuous physics: yields, energy and safety windows decided by process telemetry. Advanced process control plus predictive maintenance plus energy intelligence is the classic compounding stack — now with agentic planning on top. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in apc/advanced control, predictive maintenance, batch genealogy/investigation, with energy optimization close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
For Process Industries & Chemicals, the queues and waits that come up first:

items: APC setpoints static while feedstock shifts; yield and energy losses accepted as normal.
Compressors, columns and boilers hold failure precursors nobody sees.
SIS/DCS estates face convergence threats with physical consequence; IEC 62443 incomplete.
Batch records, quality and ERP data disjoint; investigations slow and audits painful.
Steam/power/cooling costs per unit unknown; optimization targets guessed.
Blend/formulation spaces are combinatorial; incumbent search stops early.
